definitionZh: 选项卡组使用[选项卡](/docs/components/tab) 和[选项卡面板](/docs/components/tab-panel)。每个面板都应该有一个在选项卡组中唯一的名称，并且选项卡应该有一个指向相应面板名称的“panel”属性。
sourceDefinition: Tab groups make use of [tabs](/docs/components/tab) and [tab panels](/docs/components/tab-panel). Each panel should have a name that's unique within the tab group, and tabs should have a `panel` attribute that points to the respective panel's name.
